name: Sheep & Love
source:
You move to la Vallée d'Ossau in the French Pyrénées with your best friend. Your goal: raise cute sheep and sell their wool on markets!

You meet the locals and are surprised to see that they're all: super nice, great musicians and... find you to be the most fascinating person in the Valley.

Which single are you going to get closer to?

[From [url=https://miramar.itch.io/sheep-and-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和最好的朋友搬到了法国比利牛斯山脉的奥索谷。你的目标：饲养可爱的绵羊并在市场上出售它们的羊毛！

你遇到了当地人，并惊讶地发现他们都是：超级友善、伟大的音乐家，而且……发现你是山谷中最迷人的人。

你想更接近哪一首单曲？

[来自[url=https://miramar.itch.io/sheep-and-love]itch.io[/url]]
